invariants.rationale: If orders is null, the method returns early with 0.0, so at this point it must be non-null.
If orders is empty, the method returns early with 0.0, so at this point it must not be empty.
The total price is computed by summing order prices (possibly discounted), all of which are non-negative, so the result cannot be negative.
If the list was empty, the method would have returned 0.0 earlier, so it must contain at least one element at exit.
The method only returns result == 0.0 if orders is null or empty; otherwise, orders.size() > 0.
